text:
alex: Heads-up — found partner webhook creds & a small set of KMS-wrapped blobs in a partner GCS bucket during a routine scan. Need coordinated cleanup + RBAC hardening + audit logging. tagging @maria @sunil for Vault/KMS.

maria: Which environments are affected? production, staging, or partner-sandbox?

alex: Primarily staging and a partner-managed bucket we have access to: gs://partner-backups/wrapped-2026-03-05.enc and a few older blobs. No evidence of broad exfiltration yet, but some CI service account used to upload.

sunil: Do we have the SA identified? If it's a CI SA we should immediately freeze its OAuth tokens and revoke short-lived creds. I can block the service account and create an emergency impersonation block if needed.

jen: Audit logging note: enable Data Access / Admin logs for Cloud KMS and GCS on the partner project so we can see who/who-called decrypt/unwrap. Also enable Vault audit devices for transit and kv paths. We need event-level traces before we rotate keys.

paul: Proposal for an ordered plan (low blast radius):
1) Freeze the implicated CI service account (disable keys, rotate OIDC binding) — owner: @sunil
2) Snapshot current KMS key version (keep as fallback) — owner: @paul
3) Rewrap affected blobs to a new KMS key version (create new version instead of creating whole new key) — owner: @paul
4) Rotate Vault transit key used for sealing secrets and rewrap sealed blobs in Vault — owner: @maria
5) Update k8s sealed secrets / sealedsecret controller config and reapply — owner: @jen
6) Enable/collect audit logs and attach to INC ticket — owner: @security-bot

alex: Add a canary run in staging before partner-prod. If rewrap fails we can revert to previous key version (we must not delete old versions until rollback window closes).

sunil: Quick commands for reference:
```
# list suspect objects
gsutil ls -L gs://partner-backups | grep wrapped-2026-03-05
# create new KMS key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-wrapping-key --location=global --keyring=infra-kr
# rewrap a blob (example)
gsutil cp - gs://partner-backups/wrapped-2026-03-05.enc | gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --plaintext-file=- --key=projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/infra-kr/cryptoKeys/redwood-wrapping-key/cryptoKeyVersions/2 | gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/infra-kr/cryptoKeys/redwood-wrapping-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - gs://partner-backups/wrapped-2026-03-05.rewrapped.enc
```
(we'll script the stream properly, placeholder above)

maria: For Vault transit rewrap we should use `vault write transit/rekey` pattern and ensure the old key is kept as a key version alias for 24h during the canary. Also update Vault audit devices: JSON logging to our secure logging bucket.

paul: I'll prepare the rewrap script and a small RBAC checklist:
- revoke SA keys and remove roles: roles/storage.objectAdmin on partner bucket, roles/kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on wrapping key
- create a constrained temporary SA for the rewrap job with only read/write to the specific bucket and kms/cryptoKey versions encrypt/decrypt for just the new version
- ensure no broad `roles/owner` bindings show up in policy

ops-bot: runbook-job started: rewrap-candidate-check (job_id=rj-2026-03-05-01) — will report status in thread. :gear:

security-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-47 and attached initial findings + audit enable checklist. Adding timeline and owners.

alex: Risk/rollback notes — do NOT delete old KMS versions or Vault key versions until we've verified 48h of healthy traffic and successful decrypts. If partner integration breaks, we can re-add the old key version alias to restore access.

jen: One more: Update our model serving infra (Dedicated) that uses sealed secrets for model keys. We need to coordinate a short maintenance window to re-seal and rollout; otherwise model serving can intermittently fail due to decryption errors. Schedule maintenance after staging canary passes.

maria: I'll own the Vault transit rotation. Can we schedule the canary at 15:30 PT today? I need @paul and @sunil available for immediate rollback.

alex: 15:30 PT works for me. @paul @sunil ack?

paul: ack. I'll be on standby and have the snapshot + script ready.

sunil: ack. Freezing SA now and recording the action in the ticket.

security-bot: Action log updated: SA frozen by sunil @ 1765001500, rewrap job queued rj-2026-03-05-01.

maria: Great — we'll run staging canary, validate app decrypts, then rewrap partner objects and rotate Vault transit key. Posting postmortem template to INC-2026-47 after cleanup. :white_check_mark:
